info.title: rentfree
info.description: Agents log what they see and what they are given; rentfree turns it into searchable, attributable memories and hands back the context for the next turn, within a token budget. Every request under /v1 carries an API key as a bearer. Every POST under /v1 that writes takes an Idempotency-Key header.
